question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 4'** i.e. **'Earlier'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **sentence suggests** that deserts existed to a significant extent during former periods of global arid climate.
 
• The word **"much" **indicates a substantial occurrence of deserts.
 
• **In this context**,** "earlier" **is the appropriate word choice, indicating that deserts existed in earlier times or prior to other periods of global arid climate.

Therefore, the **correct sentence **is: *Deserts probably existed much **earlier, **during former periods*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1**, "early," does not convey the comparative sense required in the sentence. It simply denotes an early time, without highlighting a comparison.
 
• **Option 2**, "earliest," implies the superlative form and does not fit the sentence structure. The sentence does not require comparing the deserts to other time periods.
 
• **Option 3**, "earnest," is unrelated to the context and does not make sense in the sentence.
